title: Pow(x, n)
kidExplanation: Picture the puzzle 'Pow(x, n)'. Here is the clever trick in plain words: The problem is to calculate x raised to the power n. We can solve this problem using the concept of exponentiation by squaring. If n is even, we can compute x^n as (x^(n//2)) * (x^(n//2)). If n is odd, we can compute x^n We will still start slow, then use this trick so it becomes fast.
